from shop.publish import Store, release


def test_release(tmp_path):
    store = Store(tmp_path)
    release(store, "a1")
    assert (tmp_path / "a1").exists() and (tmp_path / "pub-a1").exists()


def test_temporary_release_skips_the_save(tmp_path):
    store = Store(tmp_path)
    release(store, "tmp1")
    assert not (tmp_path / "tmp1").exists() and (tmp_path / "pub-tmp1").exists()
